question: Are drop/promotion moves over-represented among first-divergence choices relative to their availability in the same positions?

games.use: seed -> two games with start_ply and move list

method.position_reconstruction: sample_start(compiled, seed) as in check_judged_divergence.py, then apply the parsed shared prefix moves[:first_diff_ply]; assert start ply, action repr round-trip, and that both games agree on the prefix
method.action_parse: BoardMove(from_square, to_square, promotion_target_id) and DropMove(base_type_id, to_square) reconstructed from the saved repr text
method.legal_mix: classify every legal_actions(state, compiled) entry as drop / promotion / quiet
method.units: 45 judged cells and 35 distinct positions (dedupe key from distinct_position_strata.py)

endpoints_written_in_advance.primary: observed drop/promotion share among the chosen first-divergence moves (served 45 choices, blind 45 choices) versus the availability share p = sum(class actions)/sum(all legal actions) over distinct positions
endpoints_written_in_advance.secondary: per-cell availability of the chosen class; count cells where the chosen class was available (expected 45/45 if reconstruction is correct)
endpoints_written_in_advance.interpretation_rule: call a class 'over-represented' only if its observed chosen share exceeds its pooled availability share by at least 10 percentage points; otherwise report 'consistent with availability'; report exact values either way
endpoints_written_in_advance.no_test: no significance test; positions are correlated through colour-swapped pairs, shared starts and duplicate depth cells

checks_before_reporting: action repr round-trip exact for every prefix move and both candidates
both games of a seed share the stored prefix
chosen class is legal in its position
limits_to_state: Availability is measured on the legal move set, not on any policy distribution; over-representation is not evidence of strength or error.
The blind arm and the judge share hand_weight=0.0, so blind-side drop concentration may reflect shared evaluation rather than quality.
Colour-swapped pairs and duplicate depths correlate the cells; exact counts are descriptive.
A drop move can be a capture-to-hand or a plain hand drop; this tally does not separate them.
No promotion/hand interaction claim follows from the class mix alone.

output.overwrite_guard: refuse if the result path already exists
